name: Big Sur South Block 13 original 5 m bathymetry and derived terrain class

producer.name: CSU Monterey Bay Seafloor Mapping Lab

units.derived_terrain_class: original categorical cells, rough/smooth and depth band

temporal.update_cadence: Static 2011 acquisition; monthly archive integrity and catalog check

provenance.access_service: NOAA NCEI archive of original CSUMB survey; same source as the terrain class
transformations: Opened SHA-256-pinned original ArcInfo bathymetry and habitat grids; counted valid cells and computed their envelope and value range without datum conversion or fishing-target generation.

evidence.supports: Original Block 13 survey identity, cruise extent and products.
Producer metadata identifies NAVD88 Geoid09, survey methods and unresolved access/use constraints.

Original archive SHA-256 3bb322d9f68c107e6bc78a492677ad229fb663aa1c8c6b7d9ac249b488324d49; 762,998 valid 5 m bathymetry cells, maximum elevation -78.32 m NAVD88. Exact audit: dist/data/csumb-bss-native-source-review.json.

limitations: No valid Block 13 cell is within a 200 ft depth ceiling; its shallowest NAVD88 elevation is -78.32 m before chart-datum conversion. It cannot yield a within-limit bottom-fishing point.
The valid-cell envelope includes unsurveyed holes and is not an exact habitat polygon or safe route.
Terrain class derives from the bathymetry and is not independent rock or fish evidence.
Producer redistribution rights, chart datum/uncertainty, current hazards, MPAs and access remain unresolved.
